title: [bug] tunnel_auth: revoked-post resubmission returns Revoked but regression test expects Replay
description: lichen-gateway/src/tunnel_auth.rs test revocation_root_change_expiry_and_lru_fail_closed (tunnel_auth.rs:921-975) fails deterministically on current main at :954-957: after table.revoke(second_claim...) succeeds, re-accepting the identical root post (accept_post(second.body..., own, 3)) returns Err(TunnelAuthError::Revoked) while the regression test asserts Err(TunnelAuthError::Replay). Repro: cargo test -p lichen-gateway --lib tunnel_auth::tests::revocation_root_change_expiry_and_lru_fail_closed (2/2 runs failed; 211 other lib tests pass). Root cause to adjudicate: accept_post() check ordering now classifies the revoked-then-replayed post as Revoked (revocation check precedes replay-window check), but the test (and possibly spec/06 tunnel-auth text) treats replay as the expected failure class for an identical resubmitted post. Decide the canonical classification: if Revoked-first ordering is deliberate (fail-closed on revocation before anti-replay), update the test assertion and any spec text; if replay-first is canonical, fix accept_post ordering and re-run the full revocation/expiry/LRU matrix. Discovered while validating bead 5rx2 (unrelated subsystem; no code was changed).
close_reason: Adjudicated: Revoked is the canonical classification; fixed the regression test's expectation (tunnel_auth.rs:954-961). Basis: revoke() deletes the accepted entry but retains a revoked floor (tunnel_auth.rs:257-267), so after revocation accept_post cannot distinguish a byte-identical replay from a stale-seq post — the design keeps no post-revocation entry cache. The floor check therefore deliberately classifies every equal/stale-seq post against a revoked floor as Revoked via the explicit retained.revoked branch (tunnel_auth.rs:316-320), which is strictly more informative than Replay and equally fail-closed. The test expectation required a distinction the design does not maintain and was committed red alongside its own implementation (both arrived in 660b9bf3bf; never green). Non-revoked replay still reports Replay (unchanged, asserted elsewhere). Spec is silent on the ordering. Verification: cargo test -p lichen-gateway all suites pass (212 lib + 3 integration), clippy clean, fmt clean.
